title: Wiring Diagram - Cooling System and Related Components

content.description: Electrical wiring diagram showing connections for cooling system components including water temperature sensors, fuel sender, volt meter, tach, rear window defogger, back-up lights, timer relay, and radiator fan relay. The diagram shows wire routing and connections from various components to the TCCS ECU (T-13), main relay (J-1), and other electrical components. Wire colors and connection points are indicated throughout.

content.text: Wire color codes visible in diagram: W (White), Y-G (Yellow-Green), Y-R (Yellow-Red), BR (Brown), R (Red), B (Blue), G (Green), L (Light Blue), BL (Black)

content.description: Small inset diagram showing a top-down view of what appears to be a relay or connector component with terminal positions marked
